intro: Wednesday June 25. Three conviction changes since the June 24 long-term update. UPGRADE: SK Hynix (000660.KS) long-term conviction upgraded from MEDIUM to HIGH — Micron's $41.5B Q3 beat + $50B Q4 guidance directly confirms HBM4 demand is structural and SK Hynix's 58% market share is validated by a direct competitor's forward guidance; this is the most powerful third-party HBM demand confirmation SK Hynix could receive. CONFIRMED: NVDA HIGH conviction strengthened — simultaneous Micron $50B Q4 HBM + Qualcomm Dragonfly (C1000 CPU + AI300 inference accelerator, Meta as anchor) deliver the dual supply-chain and demand-stack confirmation that resolves the June 23 Black Tuesday panic narrative as KOSPI-driven forced liquidation, not a fundamental AI capex deceleration signal. CONTEXT: Qualcomm Dragonfly data center debut with Meta as first customer ($15B data center revenue by 2029 target; QCOM +12%) validates the AI inference demand layer adjacent to NVDA's training dominance — this is a complementary, not competitive, signal for AI infrastructure buildout. BTC long-term conviction remains LOW — non-participation in the strongest AI fundamental session of the 2026 cycle (BTC +0.4% vs NQ +2.1%) strengthens the structural breakdown thesis rather than refuting it; re-entry framework unchanged (two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000 required). SPCX HIGH conviction unchanged — bond distribution Day 3 of est. 10–12 business day clearance window; $89B demand validated; September 2 first earnings thesis intact. Macro gates as of June 25 premarket: VIX 18.32 (above 17, tightening), DXY 101.27 (above 100, tightening). May PCE at 8:30 AM ET (12:30 UTC) is the final regime gate event — cold PCE (core below 3.2%) on WTI $69.42 / Brent $73.05 (-5.2%) disinflation inputs clears both gates for all long-duration AI theses.

ideas.name: NVIDIA
ideas.idea: DUAL AI DEMAND CONFIRMATION — Micron $50B Q4 validates HBM supply chain; Qualcomm Dragonfly (Meta anchor) validates inference-stack buildout; the June 23 Black Tuesday panic confirmed as forced liquidation, not fundamental deceleration. Structural accumulation window at $200–$210 strengthened.
ideas.why: Two simultaneous June 24 AH events deliver the definitive AI capex cycle confirmation: (1) Micron Q3 $41.5B (vs. $34.66B consensus) + Q4 $50B guide — HBM4 sold-out through 2026-2027 is the most direct validation of NVDA's Vera Rubin memory supply chain available from a third party; if Micron can deliver $50B Q4, NVIDIA's memory supply chain is not at risk; (2) Qualcomm Dragonfly (C1000 CPU + AI300 inference accelerator, Meta as anchor customer, $15B data center revenue by 2029) confirms AI inference spend is expanding to full-stack silicon — every hyperscaler building Qualcomm inference servers also requires NVDA GPUs for training; the inference stack and training stack are complementary. The June 23 SOXX -7.88% / NVDA -3.09% at 24M shares (16% of 30-day average) is now definitively classified as KOSPI-forced institutional liquidation, not a fundamental AI deceleration signal. NVDA at $207–$212 (est. premarket June 25) is approximately 30x forward FY27 earnings — the most compelling structural accumulation window since early 2026.
ideas.driver: Hyperscaler + sovereign AI capex compounding through 2028+ (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, xAI committed through 2027); Vera Rubin rack-scale systems entering production 2026–2027 with HBM4E supply chain confirmed by Micron $50B Q4 guide; CUDA ecosystem expanding into robotics and physical AI (Project GR00T, NeMo); inference demand wave following training ramp creates durable second-cycle revenue; Qualcomm Dragonfly validation of the inference-as-complement-not-substitute thesis; 62-analyst consensus PT ~$299 = +43% from current levels.
ideas.risk: Custom ASICs (Google TPU v6, AWS Trainium 3, Meta MTIA 2) erode H100/H300 inference share faster than expected over 2027–2028, particularly after Meta commits to Qualcomm Dragonfly inference hardware; sustained 30Y above 5.25% compresses AI-capex multiples; PCE hot print June 25 extends macro gate failures into July; NVDA management guides cautiously on Vera Rubin supply chain cadence at next public event.

ideas.name: SK Hynix (000660.KS)
ideas.idea: UPGRADED TO HIGH CONVICTION — Micron's $50B Q4 guide directly validates SK Hynix's 58% HBM market share thesis; June 25 KST close ₩2,917,000 (+11.1%); ₩2,000 from ATH close reclaim; framework stop ₩2,540,000 intact with ₩377,000 buffer; HBM4 capacity slowdown narrative refuted by Micron's forward guidance.
ideas.why: Micron's $50B Q4 HBM guide is structurally definitive for SK Hynix conviction: if MU is guiding $50B Q4 (vs. ~$36B prior consensus) — a $14B Q4 upward revision — then HBM4 demand is not being cut, it is accelerating. The June 23 Korean media report of 'HBM4 capacity slowdown' is now refuted by a direct competitor who would know: Micron would not guide $50B Q4 AI memory revenue if HBM4 supply were actually being curtailed industry-wide. SK Hynix's 58% HBM market share means it captures approximately $29B of MU-equivalent incremental demand on a revenue-share basis. The June 25 KST +11.1% close at ₩2,917,000 (KOSPI +5.42% to 8,930.30) is the highest SK Hynix close since the June 23 Black Tuesday reversal — ₩2,000 below the ATH close reclaim level. Framework stop ₩2,540,000 now has ₩377,000 buffer (the most comfortable stop margin since the ADR SEC clearance and July 29 Q2 earnings catalysts remain ahead). Long-term conviction upgrade to HIGH is warranted by: (1) third-party (MU) direct confirmation of HBM4 demand; (2) KOSPI structural regime recovery; (3) Qualcomm Dragonfly AI300 inference accelerator creating a second HBM demand channel beyond GPU training.
ideas.driver: HBM4 → HBM4E product leadership with 58% global market share; Micron $50B Q4 guide directly validating HBM demand structural magnitude; NVIDIA supply lock through 2030; Qualcomm Dragonfly AI300 inference accelerator creating second HBM demand channel; ADR Nasdaq listing (est. July–August 2026) triggering US passive fund structural demand channel ($14B ADR raise + ₩75T+ buyback); KOSPI 9,000+ inflow thesis; sell-side PT revision cascade to ₩3.0M+ on Micron confirmation.
ideas.risk: Samsung executes credible HBM4E qualification with NVIDIA before SK Hynix completes certification — direct market-share threat with specific named customer evidence; ADR SEC clearance delayed materially beyond June; Korea geopolitical escalation during a risk-on KOSPI recovery; SK Hynix management officially confirms HBM4 capacity slowdown before July 29 Q2 earnings (contradicting the Micron data).

ideas.name: Microsoft
ideas.idea: Lowest-risk AI monetization path — contracted Azure AI subscriptions insulate against VIX/DXY macro stress; Micron $50B Q4 + Qualcomm Dragonfly Meta anchor simultaneously confirm Azure AI workload growth trajectory; Copilot enterprise adoption compounding at increasing pricing tiers.
ideas.why: Microsoft's structural AI thesis has been strengthened by three simultaneous June 24 AH signals: (1) Micron $50B Q4 HBM confirms Azure AI workload growth expectations — Azure is a primary HBM customer through its Maia 100 accelerator program and NVIDIA-based Ultracluster infrastructure; (2) Qualcomm Dragonfly with Meta anchor validates the enterprise AI inference market that Azure serves via its AI Studio platform; (3) WTI $69.42 / Brent $73.05 (-5.2%) disinflation improving cold PCE probability — lower rates structurally benefit MSFT's contracted subscription model re-rating. Microsoft's competitive moat is rate-insensitive on a forward 12–36 month basis: contracted enterprise Azure bookings, Copilot seat commitments at $30/month, and Teams/Dynamics/Power Platform AI integration create a defensible subscription base that is not directly exposed to VIX spikes or DXY moves. The post-FOMC dip to ~$370–$375 remains the highest-conviction entry window for the 3–5 year horizon. Qualcomm Dragonfly with Meta anchor raises a question about GitHub Copilot vs Cursor AI competitive dynamics — but the enterprise infrastructure relationship (Azure hosting Qualcomm inference servers) is more important than the developer tooling competition in the near term.
ideas.driver: Azure AI workload attach rates compounding; Copilot enterprise adoption at $30/month across hundreds of millions of seats; OpenAI frontier model differentiation bundled into Azure AI Studio enterprise pricing; Teams + Dynamics + Power Platform AI integration creating switching-cost-reinforced moat; contracted subscription revenue providing rate-insensitive cash flow base; Micron $50B Q4 direct Azure AI workload validation.
ideas.risk: AI capex-to-Azure-revenue monetization lag extends beyond H2 2026 — Azure growth deceleration signals even with Micron confirmation; SPCX Cursor AI displaces GitHub Copilot over 2–4 years in developer tooling; DOJ scrutiny of OpenAI relationship limits enterprise AI bundle pricing in EU/UK; cloud spending deceleration if BofA 3-hike 2026 forecast materializes into IT budget tightening.

ideas.name: Alphabet
ideas.idea: Cheapest full-stack AI at megacap lowest multiple — Qualcomm Dragonfly (Meta anchor) raises the Google Cloud TPU competitive positioning question; NEW STRUCTURAL POSITIVE: if Meta is buying Qualcomm AI300 for inference AND Google Cloud TPU for training, that is demand expansion, not substitution; AI talent exodus risk unchanged.
ideas.why: Three updates to the GOOGL thesis since June 24: (1) STRUCTURAL POSITIVE: Qualcomm Dragonfly with Meta anchor — if Meta is deploying Qualcomm inference hardware AND Google Cloud TPU training infrastructure in parallel, the AI data center spend is expanding to multi-vendor silicon stacks, which is net positive for Google Cloud (Meta as a Google Cloud customer already); the key clarification needed over the next 48 hours is whether Meta's Qualcomm commitment replaces or supplements Google Cloud TPU usage; (2) CONFIRMED RISK: AI talent exodus (Noam Shazeer to OpenAI, Gabriel Jumper to Anthropic) remains unaddressed — Google management has not announced a retention program; this is the moat-discount narrative that must be cleared before conviction upgrades to HIGH; (3) MACRO IMPROVEMENT: WTI $69.42 / Brent $73.05 (-5.2%) increasing cold PCE probability at 8:30 AM ET — cold PCE (core below 3.2%) clears DXY below 100 and VIX below 17, removing the two macro gates that have prevented the GOOGL upgrade. Fundamental thesis unchanged: Gemini frontier models, TPU inference cost leadership, Search cash flow funding, YouTube #2 advertising surface. At ~$341–$346 (post-FOMC), GOOGL is the lowest forward P/E in Mag-7.
ideas.driver: TPU inference cost advantage over NVIDIA GPU workloads (30–40% cost advantage at scale) creating Google Cloud AI pricing power; Gemini integration across billion-user surfaces; Google Cloud AI workload attach rates inflecting upward; YouTube and Search advertising benefiting from DXY structural decline; Qualcomm Dragonfly demand-expansion scenario (multi-vendor inference stacks) benefiting Google Cloud TPU training dominance; Q2 mid-July earnings first AI Overviews monetization data.
ideas.risk: AI talent exodus accelerates without senior management retention response — Shazeer/Jumper departures followed by additional top researchers; Qualcomm Dragonfly proves to be a Google Cloud TPU substitute rather than complement (direct competitive displacement in enterprise inference); DOJ antitrust remedy fractures the search + advertising bundle; AI Overviews proves to be session-length headwind in Q2 2026 data (reversing Q1 thesis).

ideas.name: SpaceX
ideas.idea: HIGH CONVICTION LONG-TERM UNCHANGED — bond distribution Day 3 of est. 10–12 business day clearance; $89B demand permanently confirmed franchise quality; Qualcomm Dragonfly + Micron AI demand confirmation validates Starlink data center interconnect demand thesis and Cursor AI infrastructure relevance; September 2 first earnings is the structural re-entry catalyst.
ideas.why: The June 25 context strengthens the SPCX long-term thesis on two parallel tracks while leaving the near-term step-aside framework unchanged. STRUCTURAL STRENGTHENING: Qualcomm Dragonfly with Meta anchor confirms hyperscalers are building AI inference infrastructure at unprecedented scale — Starlink's data center interconnect offering and low-latency satellite backbone become more valuable as hyperscaler AI inference deployment expands globally beyond terrestrial fiber reach; Micron $50B Q4 AI memory demand confirms the AI buildout that Starship's satellite launch economics are designed to serve (Starlink constellation expansion requires Starship, and Starlink serves the AI infrastructure demand). Cursor AI ($60B acquisition, 1M+ developers) is embedded in the AI development stack that Qualcomm Dragonfly / Meta anchor customers are using. NEAR-TERM UNCHANGED: step-aside posture through bond distribution clearance (~July 1–6); two consecutive closes above $185 required; $150 IG defense line monitoring; September 2 first earnings with $89B demand confirmation as the franchise anchor.
ideas.driver: ★ $89B bond demand (4.4x oversubscribed) — institutional fixed-income validation of IG credit quality; Starlink $20B+ annualized revenue trajectory compounding toward 5M+ subs; Starship 10–50x cost-to-orbit enabling new satellite economy; Cursor AI (1M+ developers) software revenue layer; Starshield national-security revenue base; IG cost of capital permanently lowering financing costs; Qualcomm Dragonfly + Micron $50B Q4 confirm the AI infrastructure demand that Starlink serves; September 2 first earnings = first public financial disclosure.
ideas.risk: 84x revenue multiple ($2.12T at $154.54) requires sustained multiple expansion — no public earnings data until September 2; bond distribution mechanics (est. clearance July 1–6) continue absorbing every recovery bid through the clearance period; December 9 lock-up expiry creating structural selling ceiling; September 2 earnings disappoints vs $2.14T market cap expectations — Starlink below 35% YoY growth OR Cursor AI revenue immaterial at the first disclosure.

ideas.name: Amazon
ideas.idea: AWS AI workload validation strengthened by Micron $50B Q4 + Qualcomm Dragonfly — Brent $73.05 (-5.2%) is the Hormuz logistics tailwind materializing; post-FOMC + Black Tuesday dip at $175–$180 est. is the best megacap cloud entry on the 2–4 year horizon.
ideas.why: The June 24 AH compound event provides three simultaneous AWS validations: (1) Micron $50B Q4 HBM — AWS is a primary HBM customer via Ultracluster AI infrastructure; Micron's $50B guide confirms AWS AI workload growth through 2027; (2) Qualcomm Dragonfly with Meta anchor — AWS hosts Meta's AI infrastructure and would benefit directly from Meta's expanded AI inference deployment; (3) Brent $73.05 (-5.2%) — the Hormuz logistics tailwind is materializing; Prime delivery and fulfillment center costs are directly reduced by energy cost normalization, and a Brent below $75 environment restores the logistics cost structure that was disrupted by Hormuz tensions. WTI $69.42 (below $70) is the first oil below-$70 print since 2024 — the logistics and operational cost structure for Amazon's physical fulfillment network improves structurally on sustained sub-$75 energy. Conviction remains MEDIUM (not HIGH) because: (a) AWS competitive pressure from Azure AI Studio and Google Cloud TPU is intensifying with Qualcomm Dragonfly deployments; (b) retail spending deceleration risk from BofA 3-hike 2026 forecast; (c) PCE at 8:30 AM ET is the session macro gate before adding.
ideas.driver: AWS AI workload attach rates confirmed by Micron $50B Q4; Trainium/Inferentia inference cost advantage advancing toward GPU parity; Hormuz logistics tailwind: Brent $73.05 (-5.2%) / WTI $69.42 (-5.2%) reducing Prime fulfillment and delivery costs structurally; AI-native robotics expanding fulfillment center operational leverage; Project Kuiper satellite broadband competing for enterprise connectivity; subscription and marketplace flywheel operating leverage at global scale.
ideas.risk: Cloud spending deceleration if BofA 3-hike 2026 forecast materializes into enterprise IT budget tightening; competitive pressure from Azure AI Studio and Google Cloud TPU on enterprise AI workload share following Qualcomm Dragonfly deployment (Meta as shared customer of Qualcomm + AWS may shift share); Trainium/Inferentia ramp timelines extending beyond 2027; Hormuz ceasefire collapse reversing Brent below-$75 trajectory and restoring logistics cost inflation.

ideas.name: Bitcoin
ideas.idea: NON-PARTICIPATION STRENGTHENS STRUCTURAL BREAKDOWN — BTC +0.4% while NQ +2.1%, MU +16%, SK Hynix +11.1% on the best AI fundamental session of the 2026 cycle. Long-term fixed-supply thesis intact but re-entry framework unchanged: two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000 required. Conviction LOW.
ideas.why: The June 25 session delivers the most bearish structural confirmation since the June 24 stop execution: BTC $61,325.96 at 11:01 UTC (Crypto.com MCP live), up approximately +0.25–0.40%, while NQ futures +2.1%, MU +16%, SK Hynix +11.1%, QCOM +12%, KOSPI +5.42%. The Micron $50B Q4 + Qualcomm Dragonfly dual AI demand confirmation — the most significant simultaneous AI fundamental catalyst of the 2026 cycle — drove zero BTC participation. The old regime in which BTC led AI-driven risk-on (Jan–May 2026, BTC +$30,000 from $48,200 52-week low to $98,600 high) is broken. Distribution at scale is the only explanation consistent with the data: sophisticated holders sold the May 2026 ATH approach, IBIT outflows (13+ consecutive days through early June, $4.33B / 59,400 BTC withdrawn) confirm institutional de-risking, and the June 24 stop execution at $61,078.01 UTC close removed the final support that had been in place since the halving. The 2–4 year structural thesis (fixed supply × halving compounding × ETF institutional channel × DXY structural decline) remains intact — it is the entry timing and confirmation framework that requires the two-consecutive-close gate.
ideas.driver: Fixed supply (21M BTC hard cap) meeting compounding institutional demand through ETF products (IBIT, FBTC, ARKB combined AUM $28B+); April 2024 halving supply reduction creating structural supply deficit that compounds over 3–5 years; DXY structural decline potential (WTI $69.42 / Brent $73.05 removing oil-inflation anchor from dollar strength); 'digital gold' thesis in Warsh no-forward-guidance policy regime; Lightning Network Layer 2 adoption expanding utility beyond store-of-value.
ideas.risk: ★ Non-participation in strongest AI fundamental session of 2026 cycle confirms structural regime change — distribution at scale is the dominant structural signal; IBIT outflows 13+ consecutive days through June ($4.33B withdrawn) confirm institutional de-risking, not accumulation; re-entry framework gate (two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000) still not cleared after June 24 stop execution at $61,078.01; BofA 3-hike 2026 forecast sustains DXY above 100 and compresses speculative assets through Q4 2026; $60,000 support test if PCE hot and risk-off resumes.
